FIELDS.NAME: City Center Mall
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: City Center Mall operates as a vibrant retail hub in Springfield, Illinois, featuring a diverse tenant mix primarily composed of low-risk businesses such as boutiques, professional offices, and essential services. The mall offers a welcoming environment with well-maintained facilities, ample parking, and enhanced security measures to ensure a safe shopping experience for customers. We prioritize compliance with local safety regulations and building codes, including regular fire safety inspections, which help mitigate potential risks. Our operations are focused on providing exceptional customer service, fostering community engagement, and creating a steady flow of foot traffic, which supports the long-term viability of our tenants. With a robust maintenance schedule in place, we strive to maintain our property at the highest standards, ensuring a safe and inviting shopping atmosphere for all visitors.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, a slip-and-fall incident occurred in the parking lot due to icy conditions, resulting in a $2,500 claim. The claim is currently closed and resolved, with proper maintenance and snow removal procedures reviewed to prevent future occurrences.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $5,000 deductible
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Enhanced security measures, including security cameras and regular patrols by security staff, along with proper fencing around the property to deter potential theft and vandalism.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – The City Center Mall does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. Operations are focused on retail activities without exposure to hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – The City Center Mall does not sponsor any athletic teams. Its focus is primarily on retail operations and community engagement through its tenant mix and customer service activities.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The property management team checks the certificates to ensure compliance and mitigate risks.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – The applicant has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – There have been no policies or coverages declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years for the City Center Mall.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – The City Center Mall does not lease employees to or from other employers; all employees are directly hired and managed by the mall's management team.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – The City Center Mall carries Workers Compensation insurance as part of its commitment to compliance and employee safety. This ensures coverage for employees in case of work-related injuries or incidents.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – The City Center Mall does not own or operate any other business. It solely focuses on its retail operations in Springfield, Illinois.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – The City Center Mall currently does not have any other insurance policies with this company aside from the ones listed. The primary policy number is CCM-2023-04567.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – The City Center Mall is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; its operations are strictly focused on retail activities and tenant services.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – The City Center Mall does not rent or loan equipment to others; its operations are strictly focused on retail activities and tenant services.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The applicant has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – The City Center Mall does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as its operations are strictly focused on retail activities without such risks.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – The City Center Mall does not have any exposure to catastrophes, as it operates in a well-maintained facility with no significant risks associated with natural disasters or similar events.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – There have been no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring for the City Center Mall. The property maintains a strong focus on compliance and risk management.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – There are no uncorrected fire code violations at City Center Mall, as the property is compliant with local safety regulations and undergoes regular fire safety inspections.
